evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; the required growth-atmosphere measurement is unavailable.
Pressure was 2.903 Torr at growth onset with Ar set to 100 sccm.
Pressure has risen monotonically to 3.184 Torr during growth despite essentially constant measured Ar flow, now 99.7 sccm; the cause is unresolved.
Thermocouple reads 750.2 C against a 750 C setpoint and status is running, but these do not verify the atmosphere.

args.missing_evidence: A verified exhaust O2 measurement is required to assess the growth atmosphere; expected growth-pressure limits and independent leak/exhaust-conductance checks would resolve the pressure trend. No sample characterization is available.
